description: Real-time updates on product candles with 5-minute granularity

unsubscribe_request.product_ids: optional - specific products to unsubscribe from

notes: Candles are grouped into 5-minute buckets. Each message may contain snapshot (full candle) or update (new candle).
use_case: Track OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) data and trading volume for technical analysis
